projects.smart-shift.title: Smart Shift Scheduler
projects.smart-shift.short: Multi-tenant workforce SaaS with RBAC, Stripe billing and a custom scheduling algorithm.
projects.smart-shift.long: Multi-tenant workforce SaaS built with Next.js, TypeScript and Supabase (PostgreSQL + row-level security). 4-tier RBAC with org-level data isolation, token-based team invitations and transactional emails. Drag-and-drop scheduling (@dnd-kit) with a shift-generation algorithm that cuts manual scheduling time ~75%, a Recharts analytics dashboard, i18n, dark mode and PWA (Lighthouse 100/100/96). Stripe subscription checkout with webhook-driven upgrades. In regular use planning shifts for a team of around ten.
projects.pos.title: Lightweight POS
projects.pos.short: Offline-first point-of-sale that keeps selling through internet outages.
projects.pos.long: Point-of-sale and inventory system for a family-run retail shop, designed and built with one other developer and now in pre-launch testing. Client-generated operation IDs are queued in IndexedDB and deduplicated server-side, so the till keeps selling through internet outages and reconciles cleanly on reconnect.
projects.gh-autocomplete.title: GitHub Search Autocomplete
projects.gh-autocomplete.short: Accessible combobox over the GitHub API, covered by 51 tests.
projects.gh-autocomplete.long: Accessible combobox over the GitHub API with debouncing, AbortController race handling and rate-limit reporting. Full keyboard navigation and ARIA semantics, 51 tests with Vitest and Testing Library, and no runtime dependencies beyond React.
projects.geosoft.title: Geosoft
projects.geosoft.short: Bilingual Next.js storefront on a headless WordPress backend.
projects.geosoft.long: Built from scratch at RED Software House: a bilingual Next.js storefront for an industrial manufacturer, consuming content from a headless WordPress backend over GraphQL. Product catalogue, publications library and search.
projects.museum.title: Warsaw Museum Collections
projects.museum.short: Legacy React modernization and shopping-cart logic.
projects.museum.long: Refactored a legacy class-component codebase to hooks and fixed the Docker environments. Implemented shopping-cart logic, reducing maintenance time and cutting editorial turnaround by 30%.
projects.elektrobohater.title: Elektrobohater
projects.elektrobohater.short: Social platform serving thousands of users, with real-time feeds.
projects.elektrobohater.long: Social platform architected from scratch with Redux Toolkit and React Query, handling real-time feeds, filtering and content management for thousands of users.
experience.exp-1.description: Built an AI assistant web client in React 19 and TypeScript, shipping its first release to a closed user community in September 2026: real-time SSE streaming, Zustand state, document generation (DOCX/PDF), file uploads and voice I/O, in an accessible i18n (PL/EN) interface. Keep the app at ~80% test coverage (Vitest + Playwright) and ship it through multi-stage Docker and Kubernetes on GitHub Actions CI/CD. Work in a Scrum team — daily stand-ups, sprint planning, pair programming and code review on every pull request — against a shared OpenAPI contract with the backend team. Deliver through the team's mandated agent-first workflow: turn tickets into specs, direct Claude Code to implement, and own architecture, review and testing, shipping routine features ~2× faster than hand-coding.
experience.exp-2.description: Designing and building Lightweight POS with one other developer, an offline-first point-of-sale and inventory system for a family-run retail shop, now in pre-launch testing: client-generated operation IDs queued in IndexedDB and deduplicated server-side, so the till keeps selling through internet outages and reconciles cleanly on reconnect. Built and shipped Smart Shift Scheduler, a multi-tenant workforce SaaS (Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase/PostgreSQL + row-level security) with 4-tier RBAC and org-level data isolation, in regular use planning shifts for a team of around ten. Implemented drag-and-drop scheduling (@dnd-kit) and a shift-generation algorithm that cut manual scheduling time ~75%, plus a Recharts analytics dashboard, i18n, dark mode and PWA (Lighthouse 100/100/96). Integrated Stripe subscription checkout with webhook-driven upgrades, token-based invitations and transactional emails.
experience.exp-3.description: Built Geosoft from scratch: a bilingual Next.js storefront on a headless WordPress backend consuming content over GraphQL — product catalogue, publications library and search for an industrial manufacturer. Built Elektrobohater, a social platform serving thousands of users, with Redux Toolkit and React Query: real-time feeds, filtering and content management. Delivered 10+ commercial projects (Next.js, Gatsby) for clients including Opera and the Museum of Warsaw, cutting initial load times ~12% via GSAP and asset optimization, in a shared codebase alongside designers, backend and QA. Mentored a junior developer with hands-on code reviews, cutting their ramp-up time ~40%, and refactored a legacy class-component codebase to hooks on the Museum of Warsaw platform.
